name: Clip-On Ear-Cuff Earbuds — LED Display Case
description: Wireless clip-on earbuds that hook over the ear like a cuff, with an oval charging case and LED display. Comes in white, black and beige.

source.notes: BLOCKER: all 3 photos (800 px) have a Chinese text panel and laurel badge. Store photos NOT made; needs clean photos. Supplier text claims (not used): BT 5.3, 48h, HiFi, CVC, sweatproof, lifetime warranty. Do not claim lifetime warranty. Overlap: store has clip-on-earbuds-led/dome/pebble (clip-on Q71, ₦10,000, ¥15.9); this is another clip-on with an oval case, so it competes with them: possible near-duplicate, owner to decide.
